answer: Because a fabricated citation fails the trellis check immediately, the delta audit keeps the resolved set and the pulse replay publishes exactly which ids were live. An answer must cite at least 5 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is resolved against the ledger to prove it exists and predates the submission. Copying the same citations across 280 aliases therefore burns the reading cost 280 times, while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. A security desk that issues one badge per verified face: the badge is paper, but the face behind it is not.
